mainTopic: The dispute about קידושין 'through the levirate bond' after חליצה, and a line-by-line study of the משנה on acts done after חליצה, מאמר, גט and ביאה
overview: The amud opens by finishing a dispute between רבי and רבנן: a יבם did חליצה and then said 'be betrothed to me through the levirate bond.' Four explanations are given, each narrower than the last. The first is whether the זיקה is real. The second, from רב שרביא, is whether a חליצה פסולה frees her. The third, from רב אשי, is whether a תנאי works with חליצה. The fourth, from רבינא, is whether that תנאי must be a תנאי כפול. The גמרא then goes through the lines of the משנה one by one. אביי and רבא say the משנה should also teach 'nothing works after ביאה.' The תנא left it out because he preferred the case that frees the יבמה to marry anyone. The גמרא notes that the משנה does not follow בן עזאי. It tries to prove שמואל's view, and to refute רב יוסף, from the משנה's cases. Both proofs are rejected because the משנה says 'חלץ,' which only describes what was done after the fact. The proof for רבה בר רב הונא is also rejected. Finally, the גמרא asks why the משנה needs a line that seems obvious according to ריש לקיש. It answers that the תנא listed every combination of יבמין and יבמות just to complete the pattern.

steps.title: רבי's side: the bond is real, and חליצה ended it
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא continues its first explanation of the dispute. רבי holds that the זיקה (levirate bond) is real, and the חליצה wiped it out.
steps.simpleTranslation: [רבי holds that] there is a real bond, and the חליצה came and cancelled the bond.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is in the middle of explaining why רבי says the later "levirate-bond" קידושין does not work. His reason is that the זיקה is real, and the חליצה already destroyed it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the זיקה is a real legal tie, then קידושין "through the bond" depends on that bond still existing. Once חליצה has cancelled the bond, there is nothing left for those words to rest on. So the קידושין fails.

keyTerms.meaning: There is a real levirate bond tying the יבמה to the יבם
The ceremony that releases a יבמה from the יבם
It cancelled it, it uprooted it

phrases.english: [רבי holds:] there is a bond,
and the חליצה came and cancelled the bond.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the answer to the earlier question of what רבי and רבנן disagree about
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: רבי holds יש זיקה, and חליצה cancelled it, so קידושין through the bond fails

steps.title: רבנן's side: no real bond, so the words still work
steps.stepSummary: רבנן hold that the זיקה is not a real legal tie. Even before חליצה, saying "through the bond" worked only as ordinary קידושין, so it still works now.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רבנן hold there is no real bond. Think about the start: if he had said to her "Be betrothed to me through the levirate bond," wouldn't that work? So now too, it works.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives the other side of the first explanation. For רבנן, the words "through the levirate bond" never depended on a bond, so losing the bond changes nothing.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Because רבנן say אין זיקה, the old קידושין "through the bond" must have worked as plain קידושין all along. חליצה removes a bond that never carried any weight. So the same words still make a valid קידושין now.

keyTerms.meaning: There is no real levirate bond
At the start, originally (here: before the חליצה)
Be betrothed to me (the words of קידושין)
Through the levirate bond
It works, it is effective

steps.whatToRemember: First explanation: the dispute is about whether the זיקה is real. רבי says it is real (יש זיקה), so after חליצה it is gone. רבנן say it is not real (אין זיקה), so the words work as ordinary קידושין.

phrases.english: And the Rabbis hold: there is no bond.
At the start, if he had said to her:
phrases.notes: "At the start" means before the חליצה was done.

phrases.english: "Be betrothed to me through the levirate bond,"
would it not be effective?
Now too it is effective.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the opposing view to complete the first explanation
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: רבנן hold אין זיקה, so the words worked as ordinary קידושין before חליצה and still work after it

steps.title: רב שרביא: they argue about an invalid חליצה
steps.stepSummary: רב שרביא offers a different explanation. After a valid חליצה, everyone agrees the "bond" קידושין fails. The argument is only about a חליצה פסולה (invalid חליצה) and whether it frees her.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב שרביא said: With a valid חליצה, if he said to her "Be betrothed to me through the levirate bond," everyone agrees it does not work. Here they argue about an invalid חליצה. One Sage holds an invalid חליצה frees her, and one Sage holds it does not free her.
steps.whatsHappening: A new אמורא gives a second, different explanation of the same dispute. He narrows the case to a חליצה פסולה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רב שרביא grants that a valid חליצה fully ends the bond for everyone. The question becomes whether a flawed חליצה also ends it. רבי says it does, so the bond is gone and the קידושין fails. רבנן say it does not, so some bond remains and the קידושין works.

keyTerms.meaning: A valid, proper חליצה
An invalid, flawed חליצה
Frees her (from the levirate tie)
Everyone, all opinions agree
They disagree about

steps.confusionAlert: "מר... ומר" does not name who is who. Following the order of the dispute, the first מר (frees her) is רבי, and the second מר (does not free her) is רבנן.

phrases.english: Rav Sherevya said:
With a valid חליצה,

phrases.aramaic: אִי דְּאָמַר לַהּ ״הִתְקַדְּשִׁי לִי בְּזִיקַּת יְבָמִין״ —
phrases.english: if he said to her "Be betrothed to me through the levirate bond" —

phrases.aramaic: כּוּלֵּי עָלְמָא לָא פְּלִיגִי דְּלָא מַהֲנֵי.
phrases.english: everyone agrees that it is not effective.
And here they disagree about an invalid חליצה:
one Sage holds an invalid חליצה frees her,

phrases.aramaic: וּמָר סָבַר חֲלִיצָה פְּסוּלָה אֵינָהּ פּוֹטֶרֶת.
phrases.english: and one Sage holds an invalid חליצה does not free her.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Replaces the first explanation with a narrower one: the case is an invalid חליצה
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The dispute is whether a חליצה פסולה frees her: רבי says yes, רבנן say no

steps.title: רב אשי: they argue whether a condition works on חליצה
steps.stepSummary: רב אשי says everyone agrees a חליצה פסולה does not free her. Instead, they argue whether a תנאי (condition) can be attached to חליצה.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב אשי said: Everyone agrees an invalid חליצה does not free her. Here they argue whether a condition works with חליצה. One Sage holds a condition works with חליצה, and one Sage holds a condition does not work with חליצה.
steps.whatsHappening: A third explanation. רב אשי takes the point רב שרביא said was disputed, makes it agreed by all, and moves the argument to conditional חליצה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The case is now a חליצה done on a condition that was not kept. If a תנאי works with חליצה (רבנן), the failed condition cancels the חליצה, the bond remains, and the קידושין works. If a תנאי does not work (רבי), the חליצה stands, the bond is gone, and the קידושין fails.

keyTerms.meaning: A condition attached to a legal act
A condition can take effect on חליצה
A condition cannot take effect on חליצה

steps.confusionAlert: This time the first מר (a condition works) is רבנן and the second מר is רבי, the reverse of the order in רב שרביא's step.

phrases.english: Rav Ashi said:

phrases.aramaic: דְּכוּלֵּי עָלְמָא חֲלִיצָה פְּסוּלָה אֵינָהּ פּוֹטֶרֶת,
phrases.english: Everyone agrees an invalid חליצה does not free her,
and here they disagree whether a condition works with חליצה:
one Sage holds a condition works with חליצה,
and one Sage holds a condition does not work with חליצה.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַב אָשֵׁי אָמַר: דְּכוּלֵּי עָלְמָא חֲלִיצָה פְּסוּלָה אֵינָהּ פּוֹטֶרֶת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Makes רב שרביא's disputed point agreed by all and moves the dispute to תנאי בחליצה
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The dispute is whether יש תנאי בחליצה: רבנן say yes, רבי says no

steps.title: רבינא: they argue whether the condition must be stated both ways
steps.stepSummary: רבינא says everyone agrees a תנאי works with חליצה. They argue only whether it must be a תנאי כפול, a condition stated both positively and negatively.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבינא said: Everyone agrees a condition works with חליצה. Here they argue about a double condition. One Sage holds we require a double condition, and one Sage holds we do not require a double condition.
steps.whatsHappening: The fourth and final explanation. רבינא takes רב אשי's disputed point, makes it agreed by all, and narrows the argument to how the condition must be worded.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A תנאי כפול spells out both sides: "if you do X, the חליצה works; if you don't, it doesn't." רבי requires both sides, so a one-sided condition is ignored, the חליצה stands, and the קידושין fails. רבנן do not require both sides, so the condition cancels the חליצה, the bond remains, and the קידושין works.

keyTerms.meaning: A double condition, stated both ways (if yes, then this; if not, then not)
We require

steps.whatToRemember: There are four explanations of one dispute, each narrower than the last: (1) is the זיקה real; (2) does a חליצה פסולה free her; (3) can a תנאי be attached to חליצה; (4) must that תנאי be a תנאי כפול. Each later אמורא turns the earlier disputed point into something everyone agrees on.
steps.whyThisMatters: This pattern of "דכולי עלמא X, והכא ב-Y קמיפלגי" shows how the גמרא keeps shrinking a dispute until it rests on a smaller, more precise principle.

phrases.english: Ravina said:
Everyone agrees a condition works with חליצה,
and here they disagree about a double condition:
phrases.notes: "Double" means he spells out both sides: if she keeps the condition the חליצה works, and if not, it doesn't.

phrases.english: one Sage holds we require a double condition,

phrases.aramaic: וּמָר סָבַר לָא בָּעֵינַן תְּנַאי כָּפוּל.
phrases.english: and one Sage holds we do not require a double condition.

steps.triggerLanguage: רָבִינָא אָמַר: דְּכוּלֵּי עָלְמָא יֵשׁ תְּנַאי בַּחֲלִיצָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Makes רב אשי's disputed point agreed by all and narrows the dispute to תנאי כפול
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The dispute is whether a תנאי כפול is required: רבי says yes, רבנן say no

steps.title: Why doesn't the משנה also say 'nothing works after ביאה'?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the משנה's case of acts done after חליצה and asks why the משנה does not also state that nothing works after ביאה.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה said: 'If he did חליצה, then a מאמר, then gave a גט, then had relations,' and so on. So the משנה should also say: 'After ביאה nothing works!'
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא goes back to the משנה and points out something that seems to be missing from its wording.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה lists two orders of events: חליצה first, and ביאה first. For the first order it sums up with 'nothing works after חליצה.' The גמרא asks why it gives no matching summary for the second order, since after ביאה the woman is fully his wife and nothing else should matter either.

keyTerms.meaning: A rabbinic 'betrothal' that a יבם gives to a יבמה with money or a document
Relations, which is the full act of יבום
'Let it also teach': a question about wording that seems to be missing
Nothing takes effect after ביאה

phrases.english: He performed ḥalitza and then made a levirate betrothal
and gave a bill of divorce and had relations, etc.
phrases.notes: The 'etc.' points to the rest of the משנה line, which also lists the reverse order: relations first, then the other acts.

phrases.english: So let the משנה also teach:
Nothing takes effect after relations?

steps.triggerLanguage: וְנִיתְנֵי נָמֵי אֵין אַחַר בִּיאָה כְּלוּם
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Returns from the רבי/רבנן dispute to the wording of the משנה
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The משנה sums up after חליצה but not after ביאה, even though the logic is the same for both.

steps.title: אביי and רבא: Add the words to the משנה
steps.stepSummary: אביי and רבא agree that the משנה really should say 'nothing works after ביאה.'
steps.simpleTranslation: אביי and רבא both say: Teach it this way: 'After ביאה nothing works.'
steps.whatsHappening: Two אמוראים accept the question and say the line belongs in the משנה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: They do not defend the missing words. They agree the rule is true and fits the משנה, so the משנה can be learned as if it says this too.

keyTerms.meaning: Both of them
'Teach it' or 'recite it': read the משנה this way

phrases.english: Abaye and Rava both say:
Teach: Nothing takes effect after relations.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 6 by agreeing the line should be there
steps.terutzResolutionType: Accepts the point and adds the words
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The missing words might mean the rule is different after ביאה
steps.terutzMaskana: The rule is true. Nothing works after ביאה, and the משנה can be read that way

steps.title: So why did our משנה leave it out?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why the תנא of our משנה did not say it himself.
steps.simpleTranslation: And our תנא? Why didn't he say it?
steps.whatsHappening: This short question sets up the next step. If the rule is true, the גמרא wants to know why the משנה left it out.
steps.deeperAnalysis: אביי and רבא agreed the rule is correct. That leaves a new question: what reason did the author of the משנה have for not writing it?

keyTerms.meaning: Our תנא, the author of our משנה

phrases.english: And the tanna of our mishna?
phrases.notes: He means: why didn't our תנא write that line?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Follows from step 7: if the line is correct, why was it left out?
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why the משנה did not write 'nothing works after ביאה'

steps.title: The משנה prefers the case that frees her to marry anyone
steps.stepSummary: The תנא chose to stress חליצה, which lets the יבמה marry anyone, over ביאה, which keeps her married to the יבם.
steps.simpleTranslation: Freeing a יבמה to marry anyone is more important to him.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains why the משנה chose to sum up only after חליצה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Both summaries are true. The תנא picked the one about חליצה because that case ends with the woman free to marry anyone. He cared more about stating that outcome.

keyTerms.meaning: Permitting the יבמה to marry anyone from the public
It is preferable or more important to him

steps.whatToRemember: Nothing works after ביאה, just as nothing works after חליצה. The משנה only spelled out the חליצה line because it cared more about freeing her to marry.

phrases.english: Permitting a yevama to marry anyone from the public
is preferable to him.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 8
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The תנא preferred to state the outcome that frees the יבמה to marry anyone

steps.title: Our משנה does not follow בן עזאי
steps.stepSummary: The משנה says its rules apply to one יבמה or two, and the גמרא notes that this disagrees with בן עזאי.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה said: 'Whether it is one יבמה or two יבמות.' Our משנה does not follow בן עזאי.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא moves to the next line of the משנה and says which תנא it disagrees with.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה treats a מאמר after a מאמר the same way whether there is one widow or two. The גמרא says this does not fit בן עזאי, who sees a difference between these cases.

keyTerms.meaning: The widow who falls to her late husband's brother
A תנא with his own view on a second מאמר
'Not like': not following someone's view

phrases.english: Whether one yevama,
or two yevamot.
Our mishna is not in accordance with ben Azzai,

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves to a new line of the משנה
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The משנה, which makes no difference between one יבמה and two, disagrees with בן עזאי

steps.title: The ברייתא of בן עזאי
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא shows that בן עזאי makes a difference: a second מאמר works with two brothers and one widow, but not with one brother and two widows.
steps.simpleTranslation: As we learned in a ברייתא: בן עזאי says a second מאמר works when there are two brothers and one widow. A second מאמר does not work when there are two widows and one brother.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings the source that shows what בן עזאי holds.
steps.deeperAnalysis: בן עזאי says a second מאמר works only when a different brother gives it to the same woman. If the same brother gives a מאמר to a second widow, it does nothing. Our משנה treats both cases the same, so it cannot follow בן עזאי.

keyTerms.meaning: As we learned in a ברייתא
Brothers-in-law who could do יבום
The brother who does יבום

steps.whatToRemember: בן עזאי: a second מאמר works with two brothers and one widow, but not with one brother and two widows. Our משנה does not make this difference.

phrases.english: As it is taught: Ben Azzai says:
Levirate betrothal takes effect after levirate betrothal
with two yevamin and one yevama,
but levirate betrothal does not take effect after levirate betrothal
with two yevamot and one yavam.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the source behind step 10
steps.raayaObject: That the משנה does not follow בן עזאי

steps.title: Does the משנה support שמואל?
steps.stepSummary: The משנה's case of 'מאמר to one, חליצה to the other' seems to support שמואל, who says חליצה done with the woman who got the מאמר does not free her צרה.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה said: 'How so? A מאמר to this one,' and חליצה to that one. Shall we say this supports שמואל? שמואל said: If he did חליצה with the woman who received the מאמר, her צרה is not freed.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא suggests that the way the משנה sets up its case backs up a ruling of שמואל.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the משנה, the חליצה is done with the other widow, not the one who got the מאמר. The suggestion is that the משנה avoided the מאמר woman because חליצה with her would not count for her צרה. That is exactly what שמואל says.

keyTerms.meaning: 'Shall we say it supports him?': an offered proof, often pushed away later
The woman who received the מאמר
Co-wife, the other widow of the same dead brother
She is not freed

phrases.english: How so? Levirate betrothal to this one, etc.
phrases.notes: The rest of the משנה line is 'and חליצה to that one': the חליצה is done with the second woman.

phrases.english: Shall we say this supports Shmuel?
As Shmuel said:
If he performed ḥalitza with the woman who received levirate betrothal,
her rival wife is not exempt.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves to the next line of the משנה and offers a proof from it
steps.raayaObject: שמואל's ruling that חליצה with the בעלת מאמר does not free her צרה
steps.raayaSupportSource: The משנה, which has the חליצה done with the other woman

steps.title: This would refute רב יוסף
steps.stepSummary: If the משנה supports שמואל, it would be a strong refutation of רב יוסף, who holds it is better to do חליצה with the woman who received the מאמר.
steps.simpleTranslation: And this would be a refutation of רב יוסף.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא adds that the same reading of the משנה would knock down רב יוסף's view.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רב יוסף holds that the best choice is to do חליצה with the בעלת מאמר. If the משנה shows that such a חליצה does not free the צרה, רב יוסף's view cannot stand.

keyTerms.meaning: A strong refutation that knocks down a view
An אמורא who prefers חליצה with the בעלת מאמר

steps.confusionAlert: רב יוסף's view is not quoted here. He holds that חליצה should be done with the בעלת מאמר, and that is why this reading would refute him.

phrases.english: And a refutation of Rav Yosef:

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Spells out what follows from the proof in step 12
steps.kashyaTarget: רב יוסף's view that חליצה should be done with the בעלת מאמר
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If the משנה avoids חליצה with the בעלת מאמר because it would not free her צרה, then רב יוסף's advice is wrong.

steps.title: The משנה only describes what was done, not what should be done
steps.stepSummary: The proof is pushed away. The משנה says 'חלץ' (he did חליצה), not 'חולץ' (he should do חליצה), so it is only describing an after-the-fact case.
steps.simpleTranslation: Does the משנה say 'he should do חליצה'? It says 'he did חליצה,' meaning after the fact.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא rejects the proof for שמואל, and so it also saves רב יוסף.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה uses the past tense 'חלץ', so it only reports a case where he happened to do חליצה with the other woman. It gives no instruction about which woman to choose. So nothing in it shows that חליצה with the בעלת מאמר would fail.

keyTerms.meaning: 'Does it teach?': it does not
'He should do חליצה' (instruction) versus 'he did חליצה' (description)
After the fact

steps.whatToRemember: The משנה's past tense 'חלץ' describes a case after the fact. It does not prove שמואל, so רב יוסף is not refuted.
steps.whyThisMatters: This shows a common method in the גמרא: the tense of a verb in a משנה can tell us whether it is giving an instruction or just describing what happened.

phrases.english: Does it teach 'he should perform ḥalitza'?
It teaches 'he performed ḥalitza': after the fact.

steps.triggerLanguage: מִי קָתָנֵי חוֹלֵץ חָלַץ קָתָנֵי דִּיעֲבַד
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the proof in step 12 and the refutation in step 13
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects the proof for שמואל and the refutation of רב יוסף
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The proof read an instruction into the משנה, but the משנה only describes an after-the-fact case

steps.title: Does the plural 'they need חליצה' support רבה בר רב הונא?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the משנה's case of a גט to each יבמה. It suggests that the plural 'צריכות' supports רבה בר רב הונא, who says an invalid חליצה must be repeated with all the brothers.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה says: 'A גט to this one and a גט to that one, etc.' (and they need חליצה). Let us say this supports רבה בר רב הונא, who said: after an invalid חליצה, she must go around and do it with all the brothers.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes the next line of the משנה and tries to use it as proof for a rule of רבה בר רב הונא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה uses the plural 'they need חליצה' about both women. The suggestion is that this matches רבה בר רב הונא's idea: when the חליצה setup is flawed, one חליצה is not enough, and it has to be done with everyone involved.

keyTerms.meaning: A bill of divorce. Here it is given by the יבם to a יבמה.
Let us say it supports him. The opening words of a suggested proof.
An invalid or flawed חליצה.
To go around to all the brothers, doing חליצה with each one.

phrases.english: A bill of divorce to this one and a bill of divorce to that one, etc.
phrases.notes: This quotes the משנה. It goes on to say that 'they need חליצה'.

phrases.english: Let us say that it supports
Rabba bar Rav Huna,
as Rabba bar Rav Huna said:
An invalid חליצה:
she needs to go around to all the brothers.

steps.triggerLanguage: לֵימָא מְסַיַּיע לֵיהּ לְרַבָּה בַּר רַב הוּנָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on to the next case in the משנה after the מאמר discussion ended in Step 14.
steps.raayaObject: רבה בר רב הונא's rule that an invalid חליצה must be repeated with all the brothers.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The plural word 'צריכות' in the משנה's case of a גט to each יבמה.

steps.title: 'They need' means women in general
steps.stepSummary: The proof is rejected. 'צריכות' is plural because it speaks about women in this kind of situation in general, not about both of these women.
steps.simpleTranslation: What does 'they need' mean? It means that women like this, in general, need חליצה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes away the proof from Step 15 by reading the plural word differently.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The plural does not mean each woman in this case needs her own חליצה. It describes the general rule for women in this situation, so the משנה gives no support to רבה בר רב הונא.

keyTerms.meaning: They need. A plural verb for women.
In general, of the world at large.

phrases.english: What does 'they need' mean?
They need, in general.
phrases.notes: He means women in this kind of case need חליצה, not that each woman here needs her own.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the proof suggested in Step 15.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects the whole proof for רבה בר רב הונא from this משנה.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The proof read the plural as 'both of these women'. It really means 'women in general'.

steps.title: 'גט to one, חליצה to the other' seems to support שמואל
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the משנה's case of a גט to one woman and חליצה with the other. It suggests this supports שמואל, because the יבם did חליצה with the woman who did not get the גט.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה says: 'A גט to this one, and he did חליצה with that one.' Let us say this supports שמואל.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא repeats the same kind of proof it made in Step 12. This time it uses the case of a גט instead of a מאמר.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the משנה, the חליצה is done with the second woman, not the one who got the גט. That seems to back שמואל, who prefers doing חליצה with the other woman rather than the one the יבם already acted on.

keyTerms.meaning: He did חליצה. Past tense.

phrases.english: A bill of divorce to this one, and he did חליצה with that one.
Let us say that it supports שמואל,

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Same argument as Step 12, now for the משנה's גט case.
steps.raayaObject: שמואל's view on which woman should get the חליצה.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The משנה's case: a גט to one woman and חליצה with the other.

steps.title: This would refute רב יוסף
steps.stepSummary: If the משנה supports שמואל, it becomes a strong refutation of רב יוסף.
steps.simpleTranslation: And it would be a refutation of רב יוסף!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא points out the result of the proof: רב יוסף's view would be knocked down.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רב יוסף prefers doing חליצה with the woman the יבם already acted on, here the one who got the גט. The משנה seems to show the opposite, so his view seems to be refuted.

keyTerms.meaning: A strong refutation that knocks down a view.

phrases.english: And it would be a refutation of רב יוסף!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Draws the other side of the proof in Step 17.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The משנה has the חליצה done with the woman who did not get the גט, which goes against רב יוסף's preference.

steps.title: 'He did', not 'he should do': only after the fact
steps.stepSummary: Just like in Step 14, the proof is rejected. The משנה says 'חלץ' (he did), not 'חולץ' (he should do), so it only describes what happened after the fact.
steps.simpleTranslation: Does it say 'he should do חליצה'? It says 'he did חליצה', meaning after the fact.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes away the proof for שמואל and saves רב יוסף, using the same answer as before.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A past-tense description only tells us the result if someone acted this way. It does not tell us what he should do in the first place. So both שמואל and רב יוסף can fit the משנה.

keyTerms.meaning: He does or should do חליצה. Present tense, used for an instruction.
After the fact, once it has already been done.

phrases.english: Does it teach 'he should do חליצה'?
It teaches 'he did חליצה', which is after the fact.

steps.triggerLanguage: מִי קָתָנֵי חוֹלֵץ? חָלַץ קָתָנֵי, דִּיעֲבַד
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the proof and the refutation in Steps 17 and 18.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects both the support for שמואל and the refutation of רב יוסף.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The proof treated a past-tense description as if it were an instruction for the first place.

steps.title: Why not also say 'nothing works after ביאה'?
steps.stepSummary: The משנה lists cases where nothing works after חליצה. The גמרא asks why it does not also teach that nothing works after ביאה.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה says: 'He did חליצה and then did חליצה, or did חליצה and then, etc.' But let it also teach: nothing works after ביאה!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes the משנה's list about חליצה and asks why a parallel rule about ביאה is missing.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Once a יבם has done ביאה (completed יבום), any later act also has no effect. The גמרא feels this rule belongs in the משנה right next to 'nothing works after חליצה'.

keyTerms.meaning: But let it also teach. Asks why something was left out.
Intercourse. Here it means completing יבום.
Nothing works after ביאה.

phrases.english: He did חליצה and did חליצה, or did חליצה and, etc.
But let it also teach:
There is nothing after intercourse!

steps.triggerLanguage: וְלִיתְנֵי נָמֵי אֵין אַחַר בִּיאָה כְּלוּם
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on to the next line of the משנה.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The ביאה rule is just as true as the חליצה rule, so the משנה should have said it too.

steps.title: אביי and רבא: add it to the משנה
steps.stepSummary: אביי and רבא both agree, and say the משנה should be read with the words 'nothing works after ביאה'.
steps.simpleTranslation: אביי and רבא both say: teach 'nothing works after ביאה'.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers Step 20 by adding the missing words to the משנה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: אביי and רבא do not explain the words away. They accept the question and add the ביאה rule into the text of the משנה.

keyTerms.meaning: Both of them.
Teach it this way. Used to fix or add to the text.

phrases.english: אביי and רבא both say:
Teach: There is nothing after intercourse.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of Step 20.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Changing the text: the missing line is added.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The משנה was incomplete because it left out the ביאה rule.
steps.terutzMaskana: The משנה should be taught as also saying 'nothing works after ביאה'.

steps.title: Why our תנא focused on חליצה
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא explains why our version of the משנה did not mention ביאה. Our תנא preferred the case that lets the יבמה marry anyone, which is חליצה.
steps.simpleTranslation: And our תנא preferred to teach the case that permits the יבמה to marry someone from the outside.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains why the משנה as we have it speaks only about חליצה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: חליצה frees the יבמה to marry anyone, while ביאה makes her the יבם's wife. Our תנא chose to focus on the case of freeing her, even though the ביאה rule is also true.

keyTerms.meaning: Our תנא, the teacher of our משנה.
Permitting the יבמה to marry someone from outside the family.
It is preferable to him.

steps.whatToRemember: The משנה's rule works both ways: nothing works after חליצה and nothing works after ביאה. Our משנה only spells out חליצה because it prefers to teach the case that frees the woman to remarry.

phrases.english: And our תנא:
permitting a יבמה to the outside world
is preferable to him.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְתַנָּא דִּידַן הַתָּרַת יְבָמָה לַשּׁוּק עֲדִיפָא לֵיהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains why the text that אביי and רבא added was missing in the first place.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Explains the תנא's choice of focus.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Leaving out ביאה looks like a gap in the משנה.
steps.terutzMaskana: The תנא chose to focus on חליצה because it frees the woman to marry anyone.

steps.title: Setting up a question: the line makes sense for רבי יוחנן
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes 'one יבם with two יבמות' and begins a 'בשלמא' argument. For רבי יוחנן, who holds the whole household is only under a לאו after חליצה, the משנה needed to teach that קידושין do not take effect.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה says: 'Whether one יבם with two יבמות, etc.' This is understandable according to רבי יוחנן. He said that the whole household is only under a לאו, so the משנה needed to teach us that קידושין do not take effect on women forbidden by a לאו.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is setting up its next move. It first shows how the משנה fits רבי יוחנן, which prepares a challenge for the other view in the next lines.
steps.deeperAnalysis: According to רבי יוחנן, after חליצה the woman and her צרות are only forbidden by a לאו, not by כרת. So it is a real חידוש that קידושין to the צרה does not take hold, following the view that קידושין do not work with חייבי לאוין. The 'בשלמא' wording hints that for the other view this line will be harder to explain.

keyTerms.meaning: It is understandable. Opens the 'easy' side of a question.
The whole household: the חלוצה and her צרות.
Stands under a לאו, a plain negative command, not כרת.
קידושין do not take effect.
Relationships forbidden by a לאו.

steps.confusionAlert: This is only the first half of the question. 'בשלמא לרבי יוחנן' means 'fine for רבי יוחנן'. The real difficulty, for the other view, comes in the next lines.

phrases.aramaic: בֵּין יָבָם אֶחָד לִשְׁתֵּי יְבָמוֹת כּוּ׳.
phrases.english: Whether one יבם to two יבמות, etc.
It is understandable according to רבי יוחנן,
who said the whole household stands under a לאו:
phrases.notes: This is the לאו from the words 'who does not build his brother's house' (דברים 25:9).

phrases.english: it was necessary to teach us
that קידושין do not take effect on those forbidden by a לאו.

steps.triggerLanguage: בִּשְׁלָמָא לְרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן, דְּאָמַר כּוּלֵּהּ בֵּיתָא בְּלָאו קָאֵי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on to the משנה's line that nothing works after חליצה, whether one יבם with two יבמות or two יבמין with one יבמה, and asks what new point it teaches.
steps.kashyaTarget: The other view, which disagrees with רבי יוחנן. It is not yet stated here.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The line has a clear חידוש according to רבי יוחנן. This sets up the question of what it teaches according to the view that the household is under a stricter ban.

steps.title: For ריש לקיש, the ruling seems obvious
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא completes the 'בשלמא' from Step 23. According to ריש לקיש the whole household is under כרת after חליצה, so why would the משנה need to say that קידושין don't take effect?
steps.simpleTranslation: But according to ריש לקיש, who said the whole household is under כרת, did the משנה really need to teach us that קידושין don't take effect on women forbidden with כרת?
steps.whatsHappening: This is the second half of the challenge that began in Step 23. The גמרא asks why the משנה would bother teaching something that is obvious according to ריש לקיש.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For רבי יוחנן, the household is only under a לאו after חליצה, so it is a real חידוש that קידושין don't take effect. For ריש לקיש, they are all under כרת, and everyone already knows that קידושין never take effect with חייבי כריתות. So for ריש לקיש the משנה seems to be teaching nothing new.

keyTerms.meaning: Spiritual cutting off, the punishment for the most severe forbidden relationships
The whole household, meaning all the brother's wives
Relationships whose punishment is כרת
Did it need to teach us?

steps.confusionAlert: This is not a new question. It finishes the 'בשלמא' from Step 23: the משנה works well for רבי יוחנן, but it seems unnecessary for ריש לקיש.

phrases.english: But according to ריש לקיש,
who said the whole household stands under כרת,
phrases.notes: He means the other wives, besides the one who received חליצה, go back to being forbidden with כרת.

phrases.english: did it need to teach us
that קידושין don't take effect on those forbidden with כרת?!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the בשלמא contrast begun in Step 23
steps.kashyaTarget: ריש לקיש's view that the whole household is under כרת after חליצה
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If ריש לקיש is right, the משנה's ruling is obvious, and a משנה shouldn't need to state something obvious.

steps.title: ריש לקיש points to an obvious case in the same משנה
steps.stepSummary: ריש לקיש answers with a counter-question. The last clause of the משנה says מאמר doesn't work after ביאה, which is just as obvious, since she is already a married woman.
steps.simpleTranslation: ריש לקיש could answer you: And by your logic, the last clause teaches that if one brother had relations and another made מאמר, it doesn't work. Did the משנה need to teach us that קידושין don't take effect on a married woman?
steps.whatsHappening: ריש לקיש defends himself by showing that the משנה also states an obvious rule somewhere else. This sets up the final answer in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: After ביאה the יבמה is fully the brother's wife, so obviously another brother's מאמר can't work on her. Since the משנה clearly states obvious things, the challenge against ריש לקיש loses its force. The question 'why teach something obvious?' applies to everyone, not only to ריש לקיש.

keyTerms.meaning: And by your own reasoning, a counter-challenge
The latter clause of the משנה
He had relations with her, meaning ביאה
Rabbinic betrothal of a יבמה by the יבם
A married woman

phrases.english: ריש לקיש could say to you:
And according to your reasoning,
the last clause, which teaches
one had relations and then one made מאמר,
phrases.notes: One brother did ביאה with her, and afterward a different brother tried to do מאמר.

phrases.english: did it need to teach us
that קידושין don't take effect on a married woman?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Defends ריש לקיש against Step 24 by turning the same logic against the משנה's last clause
steps.terutzResolutionType: Counter-challenge (ולטעמיך): the same problem exists elsewhere, so it cannot disprove ריש לקיש
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Every clause of the משנה must teach something new, so ריש לקיש's view makes the clause unnecessary
steps.terutzMaskana: The משנה plainly includes an obvious clause anyway, so being obvious is not a problem

steps.title: The משנה lists every case for completeness
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא explains that the משנה lists all the combinations of יבמים and יבמות to be complete, even when a case teaches nothing new.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, since the משנה taught the release of one יבם and one יבמה, it also taught two יבמות and one יבם. And since it taught two יבמות and one יבם, it also taught two יבמין and one יבמה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives the final answer. The תנא arranged the משנה as a full list of cases, so some rulings appear only to finish the pattern.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The rule 'every line must be a חידוש' does not apply here. Once the תנא started with one יבם and one יבמה, he continued with every possible combination. So the obvious ruling for ריש לקיש is explained, and his view stands.

keyTerms.meaning: Since he taught, meaning a case listed to complete a pattern
The release of the bond between יבם and יבמה
Brothers-in-law, the plural of יבם

steps.whatToRemember: A משנה sometimes includes an obvious case 'אַיְּידֵי', to complete a list. So the challenge against ריש לקיש falls away, and both רבי יוחנן and ריש לקיש can explain the משנה.
steps.whyThisMatters: The 'אַיְּידֵי' answer is a common tool across ש״ס for explaining why a משנה includes a clause that seems to teach nothing new.

phrases.english: Rather:
since he taught
the release of one יבם and one יבמה,

phrases.aramaic: תְּנָא נָמֵי שְׁתֵּי יְבָמוֹת וְיָבָם אֶחָד.
phrases.english: he also taught two יבמות and one יבם.
And since he taught
two יבמות and one יבם,

phrases.aramaic: תְּנָא נָמֵי שְׁתֵּי יְבָמִין וִיבָמָה אַחַת.
phrases.english: he also taught two יבמין and one יבמה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Builds on Step 25's point and states the real reason for the obvious clauses
steps.terutzResolutionType: Structural answer: the clause is included to complete the list of cases
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Each clause of the משנה must contain a new ruling
steps.terutzMaskana: The תנא lists every combination for completeness, so ריש לקיש's view fits the משנה
